sources.title: Aegis Logistics to acquire 89.8% stake in Dubai-based Tristar Holdings for $809 million
Aegis Logistics approves USD 809 million Tristar stake acquisition to expand global liquid logistics footprint

synopsis: Aegis Logistics will acquire an 89.8% stake in Dubai-based Tristar Holdings for an equity consideration of $809 million, which includes contingent payments and interest on deferred consideration. The sellers are Agility Tristar Holdings Ltd, Gulf Investment Corporation, and Diamond Holdings Ltd. The transaction was approved by Aegis's board on October 13 through its Singapore-based, wholly owned step-down subsidiary, Aegis Logistics International Pte Ltd. Tristar reported revenue of $1.401 billion and a net profit of $82 million for the year ended December 2025. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of FY27, subject to regulatory approvals under applicable competition and antitrust laws and other customary closing conditions.
